annotations.title: Court of Protection deputy fixed costs calculator (PD 19B)

description: Works out the fixed costs a professional or public authority deputy may take from P's estate under Court of Protection Practice Direction 19B (the 2024 version, and the December 2017 version for periods ending before 1 April 2024), fee by fee: the deputy application, the annual management fees for property and affairs (the net-assets percentage below £20,300) and health and welfare, reports to the OPG, tax returns, trustee and PD 9D applications, property management, conveyancing and travel, with part years and VAT. Where the deputy takes detailed assessment instead, it gives the SCCO fee, the 75% cap on payments on account and the time limit, never an estimate of what an assessment would allow. Every figure is a maximum. DMD Costs does not act in Court of Protection matters.

deputy.description: Who the deputy is: "solicitor" (a solicitor, an SRA-regulated trust corporation or a chartered legal executive), "other-solicitor-rates" (another professional deputy whose order authorises solicitors' rates), "public-authority" (an office holder of a public authority), "other-pa-rates" (another professional deputy on public authority rates, or whose order says fixed costs without saying which), "lay" (a lay deputy, such as a family member).

elect.description: Where order is "assessment": "assessment" (take it, as the order provides) or "fixed" (elect fixed costs instead, para 5).

estimate.description: Assessment: the estimate given to the OPG (your figure), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

filed.description: Assessment: the date the request (Form N258B) is filed, for the court fee (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: The fees to work out, one entry each (up to 20).

assets.description: Annual fees: P's total assets on the anniversary (or at the end of a part year), including P's home, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

consideration.description: Conveyancing under the 2017 text: the price, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

date.description: The date for the fee: the order date (application), the anniversary (annual fees), the date lodged (report), made (tax return, trustee or PD 9D application), contracts exchanged (conveyancing), the anniversary or completion (property), or the travel date (YYYY-MM-DD).

end.description: Part year: the date it ended (YYYY-MM-DD).

hours.description: Travel: the hours spent travelling, as a number such as "12.5" or hours and minutes such as "3:30".

kind.description: What the fee is for: "application" (deputy application), "annual" (annual fee, property and affairs), "hw" (annual fee, health and welfare), "report" (report or account to the OPG), "tax-basic" (basic tax return), "tax-complex" (complex tax return), "trustee" (trustee or s.18(1)(j) application), "pd9d" (PD 9D para 4 application), "property" (annual property management, public authority rates), "conveyancing" (conveyancing), "travel" (travel time).

liabilities.description: Annual fees: P's total liabilities at the same date, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

partYear.description: Annual fees: a management year cut short; give start and end.

start.description: Part year: the date the management year started (the order date or the last anniversary) (YYYY-MM-DD).

year.description: Annual property and affairs fee: "first" year or a "later" year.

notForProfit.description: "other-pa-rates": a not-for-profit deputy, for the fixed travel rate.

order.description: What the order provides for the deputy's costs: "fixed" (fixed costs), "assessment" (detailed assessment by the SCCO), "inter-partes" (costs paid by another party, not out of P's estate).

vatRegistered.description: A deputy who is not a solicitor or a public authority is VAT registered.

wip.description: Assessment: work in progress for the management year (your figure), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".
